gates.title: First-contact connector trust decision
gates.notes: Ship an explicit user-verifiable trust decision or equivalent transparency mechanism for a connector first seen by an application.

gates.title: Managed key service and rotation drill
gates.notes: Move the hosted provider master key into a managed key service, document rotation, and retain evidence from a successful non-production rotation drill.

gates.title: Encrypted backup and restore drill
gates.notes: Verify encrypted database and volume backups, restoration, key recovery, recovery objectives, and deletion behavior in the managed environment.

gates.title: Platform signing and notarization
gates.notes: Configure and verify canonical trust-channel signing for every supported desktop platform.
